subject: maths
question: In how much time (in years) will a sum of ₹3,125 become ₹3,515.20 at 8% per annum, compounded half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3,125

Amount (A) = ₹3,515.20

Rate of interest (r) = 8% per annum

Compounded half-yearly

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/200)²t

Where:

A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest per annum, t = Time in years

**Calculations:**

Substitute the values in the formula:

3
